metadata.name: HSU TwinFlow material-flow graph
metadata.transportedItem: Each edge has transportedItem set to pallet, piece, or defect. Pallet edges represent pallet movement. Piece edges represent normal product/piece movement. Defect edges represent nonconforming product movement to sink components.
metadata.boundaryNodes: External boundary nodes were removed. Existing nodes may have is_source or is_sink set to true when they represent a material-flow boundary.
metadata.on_pallet: True only on piece edges where the same directed source-target pair also has a pallet movement edge.
